diagnosis: Customer removed 30 seats mid-cycle and expected a $1,200 credit on invoice INV-88410. KB-0011 states seat removals take effect at renewal, not mid-cycle. The invoice likely reflects the seat count at the start of the billing period. Dispute requires specialist review.
reply: Thank you for flagging invoice INV-88410. I understand you removed 30 seats on the 3rd and expected a credit of about $1,200. According to our seat-change policy, seat removals are applied at the next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, which is why the invoice still shows the previous count. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist so our billing team can review the details and confirm how this was handled under your enterprise plan.
